summary: Parent/child tracking app with live location map; planning an in-app confirmation flow where a parent is notified and can confirm when a child registers the parent phone number.
architectural_notes: Add backend-generated internal notifications and a parent-side UI alert/confirmation action triggered by child phone-number registration.
known_issues: Build/deploy generation failed when attempting to implement the in-app notification confirmation flow ("The AI couldn't complete your request").

existing_features.title: Add a parent-facing UI alert that surfaces pending phone confirmation requests and allows the PARENT to confirm with one click.

Update the child phone pairing UI flow so that after the CHILD submits the parent phone number, the UI reflects “pending parent confirmation” state instead of (or in addition to) the current OTP-based completion step, and keeps polling/refetching until the request is confirmed.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement in-app confirmation flow: when the child enters the registered parent phone number, backend creates an internal notification; parent receives an alert and can confirm with one click.

Implement a persistent in-app notification/request flow for phone-based parent-child linking: when a CHILD submits a phone number that matches a PARENT’s registered phone number, create a pending confirmation request addressed to that parent, and block completion of the phone-based pairing until the PARENT confirms with one click.

projectName: Add in-app parent confirmation notification when child submits parent phone number
